title: Vintage Le Creuset Cast Iron Terrine with Lid – White Enamel – Rare Collectible
description:
Beautiful vintage Le Creuset terrine dish in enameled cast iron, finished in an elegant white color. This rectangular terrine comes with its original lid featuring a steam hole and classic minimalist French design. A timeless and highly collectible piece, perfect for rustic kitchen décor, pâtés, terrines, foie gras, or oven-to-table serving.
Made in France by Le Creuset, this piece combines durability with vintage charm. The interior is clean and in very good vintage condition. The exterior enamel shows small signs of age and use on the edges, consistent with vintage cookware and adding authentic character.
Approximate dimensions:
Length: 30 cm with handles
Width: 9 cm
Height: 8 cm
A rare and elegant collectible for Le Creuset enthusiasts and lovers of vintage French cookware.
